dimensions.assessment: Modifies internal coordination and oversight structures for foreign aid rather than altering broader public rights.
dimensions.evidence: responsible to the Secretary of State for matters pertaining to the creation and maintenance of allies and partners

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the new Under Secretary to receive necessary funds from existing authorizations for fiscal years 2026 and 2027.
dimensions.evidence: receive the funds necessary to fulfill the Under Secretary's responsibilities for fiscal years 2026 and 2027

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent structural changes within the Department with funding provisions for fiscal years 2026 and 2027.
